g.text: Ethereum Foundation: CROPS on Sepolia and the EIP-8141 devnet
S: a transaction signed by FORS+C alone · C: an exit that needs nobody · P: stealth hidden from quantum computers, reads nobody can trace
S · EIP-8141 devnet: one frame transaction (type 0x06)
SENDER frames, the account as msg.sender
the account pays its own gas: no bundler, no paymaster
the protocol nonce counts the key's 8 uses
C · Sepolia: a note leaves its pool with every Opaque server down
in the ring? announced? old enough?
P · Sepolia: who was paid is hidden, against quantum computers too
the payee scans: the view tag skips 255 in 256, it decapsulates its own, and the wallet sweeps the payment into notes
EF anon-rpc (the Nox mixnet) in the wallet: a sandboxed, null-origin iframe runs only the worker whose keccak matches the on-chain
specifier (0x3513…7A9A). Every ENS lookup goes through it always; the account's reads and UserOperations, with one switch.
